title: TV producer's master tape lost on his death

tellings.quote: the guy that gave it to Chuck Clark was a TV producer in Los Angeles

plain: A master tape, kept on Beta SP, a professional broadcast video format, is said to have come from a TV producer in Los Angeles who gave it to a man named Chuck Clark, and to have been lost when the producer died. The UFO investigator James Fox tells Michels this from his own part in tracking the tape down: "the guy that gave it to Chuck Clark was a TV producer in Los Angeles." If it is true, an original recording that mattered to his search went missing with the one man who had it.
